notes: §1985:X.5.3.3 SR1 requires 'Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal.' CallBinder.BindCancel reads each literal target through ProgramNameLiteral.Form, which admits only an alphanumeric (or national) string literal, and CallBinder.ProgramName reports COBOL1627 otherwise; at 85 the national N'..' and hexadecimal X'..' spellings never reach it because the edition gate refuses them first (COBOL0900), so only a 1985 nonnumeric literal is admitted. Probed at 85 (classes b, c, d, f): numeric 12 (the witness), -1, 1.5, ZERO, SPACE, ALL 'S' and the mixed CANCEL 'SUBPGM' 12 'OTHER' each draw COBOL1627 at the offending operand; N'SUBPGM' and X'535542' draw COBOL0900; the zero-length literal draws COBOL0900 and COBOL1627; CANCEL with no operand COBOL0001; CANCEL 'SUBPGM' and 'SUBPGM  ' compile and the re-called program prints CNT=1 (initial state).

next.reason: 1985: "Literal-1 must be a nonnumeric literal."; 2023: "Literal-1 shall be an alphanumeric or national literal". 2023 also accepts a national literal for CANCEL literal-1. The zero-length ban adds nothing, since a 1985 nonnumeric literal always held at least one character.
